intro: Peter Luger Steak House is the legendary Brooklyn dry-aged steakhouse, open since 1887 and famous for its porterhouse sold by the number of diners, its extra-thick bacon, German fried potatoes and creamed spinach, and its no-frills, cash-only Brooklyn room. It also has locations in Great Neck and, newer, Las Vegas. Below is the Peter Luger menu with prices for 2026.
quick_answer: At Peter Luger, the signature dry-aged porterhouse Steak for Two is about $147.90, a single steak $73.95, and a rib steak $92.95. The lunch-only Luger Burger is $21.95, extra-thick Luger bacon is $8.95 a slice, and sides like German fried potatoes or creamed spinach for two are $18.95. It is an upscale, cash-only steakhouse (at the Brooklyn original).

hot_deal: Peter Luger value: this is a special-occasion steakhouse, not a value spot, but the lunch-only Luger Burger ($21.95) is the cheapest way to taste the kitchen, and a single steak ($73.95) is far less than the porterhouse for two. The Brooklyn original is cash-only, so bring cash. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How much is the porterhouse at Peter Luger?
faqs.a: The dry-aged porterhouse Steak for Two is about $147.90, and larger sizes for three or four scale up from there and are priced at the restaurant. A single steak is $73.95 and a rib steak $92.95. Prices vary by location and update.

The Brooklyn original is famously cash-only (it also takes the Peter Luger house card), so you should bring cash. Policies at the newer Great Neck and Las Vegas locations can differ, so it is worth checking before you go.

faqs.q: What is Peter Luger known for?
faqs.a: Peter Luger, open in Brooklyn since 1887, is known for its dry-aged porterhouse sold by the number of diners and served sliced, its extra-thick bacon, German fried potatoes and creamed spinach, and its no-frills, cash-only room. It is one of America's most famous steakhouses.

faqs.q: Can you get the Luger burger for dinner?
faqs.a: No. The famous Luger Burger is served only at lunch, until about 3:45 PM, and is not on the dinner menu. At $21.95 it is the cheapest way to taste the kitchen, so lunch is the budget-friendly visit.

faqs.q: What are the most popular dishes at Peter Luger?
faqs.a: Favorites include the dry-aged porterhouse for two, the lunch-only Luger Burger, the extra-thick Luger bacon, the German fried potatoes, and the creamed spinach.
